hook: There is a three-second trick that tells you exactly how fast your money will double.

blocks.narration: There is a three-second trick that tells you exactly how fast your money will double. Bankers have used it for centuries.
blocks.visual: A brass pocket watch opens to reveal a glowing number seventy-two in place of the clock face, macro shot

blocks.narration: It is called the rule of seventy-two. Take seventy-two and divide it by your yearly return. The answer is years to double.
blocks.visual: Chalk-style clay tiles slide together to form a simple division, seventy-two over a small number

blocks.narration: Say you earn six percent a year. Seventy-two divided by six is twelve, so your money doubles roughly every twelve years.
blocks.visual: A stack of coins duplicates itself once while a clay calendar flips twelve pages

blocks.narration: At eight percent it doubles in about nine years. At ten percent, a little over seven. Small differences in return compound into enormous gaps.
blocks.visual: Three coin stacks race upward at different speeds, the fastest one pulling far ahead

blocks.narration: Now flip it around. Inflation also compounds. At three percent inflation, your cash loses half its buying power in about twenty-four years.
blocks.visual: A shopping basket full of groceries slowly shrinks to half while a dollar bill stays the same size

blocks.narration: That is why money sitting in a zero interest account is quietly shrinking, even though the number on the screen never changes.
blocks.visual: A glass piggy bank on a shelf gathers dust as the coins inside slowly fade to gray

blocks.narration: Credit card debt follows the same rule. At twenty-four percent interest, an unpaid balance can double in about three years.
blocks.visual: A red clay credit card balloons in size as a calendar flips three pages behind it

blocks.narration: Use it before any money decision: what doubles for you, and what doubles against you. Follow for one money rule like this every day.
blocks.visual: Two doors side by side, one glowing gold, one glowing red, camera slowly pulls back

cta: Follow for one money rule like this every day.

captions.hook_line: The 3-second trick to know how fast your money doubles ⏱️
captions.body: Divide 72 by your annual return to estimate how many years it takes money to double. It works in reverse too: 3% inflation halves buying power in about 24 years.
